decisions.reason: The source clarifies general HubSpot-list import behavior but does not resume or change the deferred silent-lead follow-up workflow.
Automatic list import does not change MeetAlfred configuration requirements or its subscription plan.
Importing HubSpot lists does not resolve whether Zapier can create a brand-new MeetAlfred campaign rather than select an existing campaign.
The source does not change or resume the deferred automated email campaign requirement.
HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list import does not change the channel, automation mode, or platform of the LinkedIn campaign.
The source states expected list-transfer behavior but does not change Zapier configuration, plan, or add-on requirements.
Not manually adding contacts does not alter the requirement to preserve existing MeetAlfred integrations and campaigns.
The source does not authorize use of production leads for testing or otherwise change the test-isolation constraints.
The source concerns the downstream HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred direction and does not change Apollo-to-HubSpot synchronization.
List import into MeetAlfred does not affect visibility of email or LinkedIn communication history in HubSpot.
The candidate's email integration targets remain unchanged; the list-transfer clarification belongs to the separate HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization requirement.
The source does not change HubSpot lead-management properties, stages, categorization, lists, notes, or task assignment.
